apa.name: APA Website Citation Generator
apa.pin.menuAlt: Chrome’s Extensions menu open, with the puzzle-piece button and the pin beside APA Website Citation Generator.
apa.pin.open: Open the article you want to cite, then click {product} on your Chrome toolbar.
apa.pin.pinnedAlt: The green APA Website Citation Generator icon pinned beside Chrome’s Extensions button.
apa.pin.summary: Turn a web article into an APA 7 reference.
apa.title: Get started · APA Website Citation Generator
apa.usage.heading: Create your first APA 7 reference
apa.usage.step1.body: With the article open in Chrome, click {product} on the toolbar or in Chrome’s Extensions menu.
apa.usage.step1.imageAlt: A NASA article open in Chrome with the APA Website Citation Generator icon on the toolbar.
apa.usage.step1.title: Open the extension from the article
apa.usage.step2.body: In the workspace that opens, click {readPage}. Compare the suggested author, date, title, website name, and URL with the article.
apa.usage.step2.imageAlt: The Read page details button and the form with the NASA article date, title and website name filled in.
apa.usage.step2.title: Read the article details
apa.usage.step3.body: Correct any fields that need editing. If the author appears as a single suggestion, fill in {familyName} and {givenNames}. Select {confirmSource} Then click {createReference}.
apa.usage.step3.imageAlt: The source details confirmation checkbox and the Create reference button below the reference form.
apa.usage.step3.title: Check the fields and create the reference
apa.usage.step4.body: Click {copyReference} to copy the reference to your clipboard.
apa.usage.step4.imageAlt: The generated APA 7 reference for the NASA article and its Copy reference button.
apa.usage.step4.title: Copy the APA 7 reference
apa.usage.tip: After pasting the reference, apply italics where needed and add a hanging indent.
common.language.fallback: Some of this guide is shown in English.
common.language.label: Language
common.mode.showUsage: Already pinned? See how to use it.
common.pin.heading: Pin the extension
common.pin.instructions: Click {extensions} in the Chrome toolbar, then click the {pin} beside {product}.
common.screenshot.illustration: These screenshots illustrate the English interface. Follow the written steps in your language.
etsy.control.confirmTable: I checked the table, gaps and displayed prices.
etsy.name: Etsy Scraper
etsy.pin.menuAlt: Chrome’s Extensions menu open, with the puzzle-piece button and the pin beside Etsy Scraper.
etsy.pin.open: Open an Etsy results page or shop with visible product cards, then click {product} on your Chrome toolbar.
etsy.pin.pinnedAlt: The blue Etsy Scraper icon pinned beside Chrome’s Extensions button.
etsy.pin.summary: Review visible Etsy listings and save them as a CSV.
etsy.title: Get started · Etsy Scraper
etsy.usage.example: Try the ceramic mug listings on Etsy
etsy.usage.heading: Export your first set of listings
etsy.usage.intro: Open a public Etsy search results page or shop with visible product cards.
etsy.usage.step1.body: With the Etsy tab active, click {product} on the toolbar or in Chrome’s Extensions menu. In the workspace, click {collectCards}.
etsy.usage.step1.imageAlt: An Etsy Scraper workspace linked to its source page, with the Collect loaded cards button ready.
etsy.usage.step1.title: Collect the loaded cards
etsy.usage.step2.body: Compare the table and its gaps with the source cards. Check the prices as shown on Etsy, then select {confirmTable}
etsy.usage.step2.caption: Practice listings in the Etsy Scraper workspace
etsy.usage.step2.imageAlt: The captured cards table and the checkbox for confirming the table, gaps and displayed prices.
etsy.usage.step2.title: Review the table
etsy.usage.step3.body: Click {downloadCsv} after reviewing the table. Open the saved file from Chrome’s Downloads.
etsy.usage.step3.imageAlt: The Download CSV button enabled after reviewing the Etsy Scraper table.
etsy.usage.step3.title: Download the CSV
etsy.usage.tip: If the capture has gaps, the button reads {downloadPartialCsv}. It saves the captured table with those gaps.
index.heading: Chrome extension guides
index.title: Chrome extension guides
meta.name: Meta Tag Analyzer
meta.pin.menuAlt: Chrome’s Extensions menu open, with the puzzle-piece button and the pin beside Meta Tag Analyzer.
meta.pin.open: Open the page you want to inspect, then click {product} on your Chrome toolbar.
meta.pin.pinnedAlt: The blue Meta Tag Analyzer icon pinned beside Chrome’s Extensions button.
meta.pin.summary: Scan a webpage and see its metadata in one report.
meta.title: Get started · Meta Tag Analyzer
meta.usage.heading: Inspect your first page
meta.usage.step1.body: Open the page you want to check and let it finish loading. Click {product} on the toolbar or in Chrome’s Extensions menu.
meta.usage.step1.imageAlt: The Chrome extensions guide open with the Meta Tag Analyzer icon on the toolbar.
meta.usage.step1.title: Open the analyzer
meta.usage.step2.body: In the {product} tab that opens, click {scanPage}.
meta.usage.step2.imageAlt: The Meta Tag Analyzer workspace showing the selected source URL and the Scan page button.
meta.usage.step2.title: Scan the source page
meta.usage.step3.body: Check the source URL at the top. Review the {counts} for the page title, description, and other metadata.
meta.usage.step3.imageAlt: A completed Meta Tag Analyzer report with the Chrome extensions guide as its source and the detected metadata in a table.
meta.usage.step3.title: Read the report
meta.usage.tip: Use {refreshReport} after editing the source. To save the report, choose {downloadJson} or {downloadText}.
pdf.control.confirmNavigation: I understand that internal PDF links and bookmarks will be removed.
pdf.name: Remove Blank Pages from PDF
pdf.pin.menuAlt: Chrome’s Extensions menu open, with the puzzle-piece button and the pin beside Remove Blank Pages from PDF.
pdf.pin.open: Click {product} on your Chrome toolbar to open the PDF editor.
pdf.pin.pinnedAlt: The purple Remove Blank Pages from PDF icon pinned beside Chrome’s Extensions button.
pdf.pin.summary: Remove blank or unwanted pages and save a separate PDF.
pdf.title: Get started · Remove Blank Pages from PDF
pdf.usage.heading: Remove blank pages from your first PDF
pdf.usage.navigation: If the editor shows a warning about internal links or bookmarks, read it and select {confirmNavigation} before creating the copy.
pdf.usage.navigationAlt: The PDF editor warning that internal links and bookmarks are removed from the new copy, with the confirmation checkbox.
pdf.usage.step1.body: Click {product} on Chrome’s toolbar or choose it from the {extensions} menu.
pdf.usage.step1.imageAlt: The Remove Blank Pages from PDF icon on the Chrome toolbar.
pdf.usage.step1.title: Open the editor
pdf.usage.step2.body: Click {choosePdf} in the editor and select a file from your device.
pdf.usage.step2.imageAlt: The PDF editor’s file selection screen with the Choose PDF button.
pdf.usage.step2.title: Choose a PDF
pdf.usage.step3.body: Check the box on each blank or unwanted page. Click {reviewPages} to check which pages will stay and in what order.
pdf.usage.step3.imageAlt: The blank page selected in the thumbnails and the Review remaining pages button.
pdf.usage.step3.title: Mark pages and review what stays
pdf.usage.step4.body: Click {createCopy}, then {downloadCopy}. Chrome downloads a separate PDF and keeps your original file.
pdf.usage.step4.imageAlt: The review screen’s Create new copy button and the Download new copy button that appears when the copy is ready.
pdf.usage.step4.title: Save a new copy
